name: The Daily Puff

nadir.desc: The property consists of a commercial building with a dark shingle roof and an attached light metal roof section|Neighboring buildings with white flat roofs sit on both sides|A paved parking lot with marked spaces occupies the side and rear of the lot|A public street runs along the front while an alley runs along the back|Sidewalks line the street frontage.

bravo.desc: The left side of the site shows the parking lot, a neighboring white flat-roof building, and the side wall of the shingle-roof building|Marked parking spaces occupy the lot|A public street and sidewalk run along the front|Rear paved area continues behind the buildings.

charlie.desc: The rear of the building shows a light metal roof section, a paved parking lot with marked spaces, and neighboring white and brick buildings|A rear entrance door is visible from this angle|An alley runs along the back of the property while the public street remains visible at the front of the site.

delta.desc: The right side of the site shows a neighboring brick and white flat-roof building along the street, with the shingle-roof building and parking lot behind it|Rooftop equipment sits on the flat roof|The public street and sidewalk run along the frontage and the alley runs behind the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is available from E Pine St and from the paved side and rear parking lot. The site is a small commercial building in a downtown block with neighboring storefronts and shared paved lots. Sidewalks provide pedestrian access along the street. Circulation space is available in the lot, though neighboring buildings sit close on both sides.
